idea-plugin.name: AutoTyper - Live Coding Simulator
idea-plugin.description:
AutoTyper - Live Coding Simulator

Simulates realistic typing of pre-written Java classes in the editor.

Perfect for live coding demonstrations in lectures and presentations.

  • Load Java files from a configurable folder
  • Simulate typing with adjustable speed
  • Pause/Resume/Stop controls
  • Natural typing feel with randomized delays
